item.title: AI News, Monday October 12
item.description:
Good morning Ryan, and happy Monday, October twelfth. Welcome to your AI news station. Grab a coffee, settle in, and let's go through what's been happening in the world of AI, with an ear on what it means for post-production, for your work at Metronome, and for your own films at EMRGNT.
Story one. Netflix says it has now used AI on about three hundred titles. This comes from the Hollywood Reporter, covering a panel at the Busan International Film Festival on October tenth.
